title: Noncommunicating spaces.
officialText:
Where the refrigerant-containing parts of a system are located in one or more spaces that
do not communicate through permanent openings or HVAC ducts, the volume of the smallest, enclosed occupied space shall be
used to determine the permissible quantity of refrigerant in the system.
